name: seongho-ops
description: Routes operational work to purpose-built local CLIs, opens protected Vercel previews in the Codex browser, and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility.

interface.shortDescription: Route operational CLI work, open protected Vercel previews, and provide k.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops selects the correct authenticated local CLI for external services, infrastructure, databases, deployments, observability, browser QA, runtimes, and state-changing Git work. It can securely seed Vercel deployment-protection cookies into the Codex in-app browser without exposing secrets to the model, and it bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports.
defaultPrompt: Use the correct local CLI for this operational task.
Diagnose this CLI authentication failure safely.
Open this protected Vercel preview in the Codex browser.
Free this local port with the bundled k command.
